recipe.architecture: Seven independent PointConv kernels, no cycle sharing. s0=lift60->64->32, h0=s0+PC32->32(s0); PC32->64 at2048 then PC64->64; PC64->128 at128 then PC128->128. Decode3NN->finePC128->64->concat64skip->Linear128->64; repeat3NN->finePC64->32->concat32skip->Linear64->32. Head32->128->4.
recipe.normalization: WeightNet hidden8/8 and PointConv mixing output use per-edge/per-point nonaffineLN thenReLU; WeightNet final16 ReLU. Density MLP1->16ReLU->1sigmoid has noLN/BN. Lift/head hidden and skipfusion ReLU, finalfield linear.
recipe.input: Original canonical xyz3 + original25 including actual normalized force/moment6 + original1024 xyz-only PointNet/global32. No force mask, alpha/u9, nearest input copy or case identifier.
recipe.target: Original TRAIN-only scaler encoded signed ux/uy/uz/scalarstress, complete original-node MSE/4 and unchanged weights.
recipe.schedule: Existing cached480-case order: four full120-case PythonRandom2026 passes independent of model RNG, exactly four updates per case.
recipe.gradient: Encode all original nodes once to H0[N32]; readout32768 chunks through detached H0leaf with each mean loss weighted chunk_nodes/N, accumulate all head and leaf gradients, original H0.backward once then one Adam. No cross-step latent cache or repeated whole-point encoding per readout chunk.
recipe.checkpointing: Query blocks2048, checkpoint gathered features/density/WeightNet/factorized kernel inside non-reentrant checkpoints, preserve original support and all output rows. No NxN distances, KxCin xCout kernel, perchunk fullN buffer or OOM fallback.
recipe.precision: Float32 TF32/high, no autocast, same as prior screens; physical decode and metrics float64. Neighbor/KDE geometry uses storedFP32 xyz promotedFP64.
recipe.selection: Fixed480 primary; knownDEV15 score0.5*(case-mean UrelativeL2+signedstressrelativeL2), best secondary. No dia/training-best route selection or extra budget/seed sweep.
recipe.timing: Primary comparable train starts before normalcase/target/cloud and cached point hierarchy read/H2D, ends after full encode/readout/backward/Adam/sync. Shared45CAD geometry preparation (including pureGPUFPS) separately recorded. Inference starts after input/H2D, evaluationwall includes load; overlapping fields are not disjoint sums.
